meta.title: Costs

bird.label: Per bird
bird.note: The flock. These belong in the cost of the goods sold.

marketDay.label: Per market day
marketDay.note: How often the stall goes out.

year.label: Per year
year.note: Nothing. These are paid whether or not a bird is raised.

meta.invoiceRuling: The feed invoices are deliberately not read into this repository. The ruling was made on August 26, 2026, and it accepts a known gap instead of carrying a document that would need scrubbing. What is missing is the monthly total. The rate above is invoiced.

feed.perBirdNote: Two readings of feed per bird disagree. The first is a season's spend divided by the birds it fed. The second is the published standard for the breed.

lines.label: Sausage processing
lines.note: Sausage processing is charged on the birds diverted to sausage rather than on all of them, so it is held out of the per-bird total above.

lines.label: Market vendor fees
lines.note: Market vendor fees are real and unquantified. They vary from market to market, and no reading exists to size them.

lines.label: Payment processing
lines.note: Payment processing takes a percentage of each sale plus a fee on every transaction. It is filed here instead of with the digital line, because grouping it there would understate the cost at volume and overstate it below.

lines.label: Farm liability insurance
lines.note: The insurance receipt is confirmed and the coverage is not. The policy predates the broiler enterprise and does not cover it, so a verified figure sits against inadequate cover.

lines.label: Fuel, vehicle and equipment
lines.note: The vehicle line covers markets, pop-ups and the round trips to processing. Equipment is diesel and gasoline through the season.

lines.label: Bedding
lines.note: Bedding covers the brooder across a season. The winter storage house runs a deep layer whose volume nobody has measured.

lines.label: Digital and administrative
lines.note: The digital line covers the workspace subscription, hosting, the domain and print. None of it has ever been totalled.

lines.label: Part-time helper
lines.note: The helper is held out of the total because a wage is a choice rather than a bill.

blank: The list has never been built from bank and card statements. Until it is, nothing here can claim to be complete.
Owner labor is unpriced. Build hours and chore hours are counted on the other measures and carried at nothing here.
